attributes.action: School uniform. Boys to be allowed to wear tailored shorts.
attributes.additional_details: This petition calls on the Government to encourage schools to allow boys to wear tailored shorts as part of their school uniform. As UK summers become hotter, long trousers can be uncomfortable and affect pupils’ wellbeing and concentration. Tailored shorts are smart, practical, and already accepted in many schools. This change would promote fairness, improve comfort, and give boys the same practical uniform choices available to many girls.
attributes.background: Boys should have the option to wear tailored shorts as part of their school uniform. It promotes fairness, improves comfort in hot weather, supports wellbeing and learning, and maintains a smart appearance while giving boys the same practical choices already available to many girls.

rejection.details: Specific uniform rules are a matter for schools.
